rubric.role_summary: Early-career robotics engineer deploying, debugging, and developing tractor-mounted AI camera systems at farms, with approximately half of working time at customer sites and half working from home.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Early-career robotics engineer deploying, debugging, and developing tractor-mounted AI camera systems at farms, with approximately half of working time at customer sites and half working from home.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 1+ years of relevant experience in industry or academia.
- Strong technical skills in robotics; the listed technologies are examples, not a requirement to know every one.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience optimizing robotics algorithms for embedded platforms.
- Familiarity with agriculture or outdoor equipment.
- Previous startup, outdoor adventure, or field deployment experience.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; Greater Seattle area, Washington. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

location.requirement_text: Location: California or Washington State (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in one of these places. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
source_quotes: Full-time, remote role with frequent travel (approximately 50% farm-based, 50% work-from-home).

You'll spend about 50% of your time traveling to beautiful farms (apple orchards, vineyards, nut farms, strawberry farms, etc) across California, Washington, and occasionally other parts of the country.

soft_requirements: Self-motivated; able to solve problems independently in unstructured environments.
Excellent interpersonal skills and excitement about engaging with customers.
Comfort with time in farm fields and interest in outdoor work.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)
resolved_ambiguities: The Hybrid workplace metadata and listed San Francisco and Seattle locations do not explain how they apply to the description's full-time remote, work-from-home arrangement. Clarify whether either city is a required home base or office location.
interpretation.resolution: Text supplies remote work plus 50% farm travel; the stated SF/Seattle location alternatives constrain the remote home base to either general area. Travel sites are not extra home-base alternatives.
